messages:
Mira (CSM): Quick heads up — Nimbus Health (Enterprise, renewal in 6w) requested a hands-on preflight session. They report slow progress on deduping embeddings; we should cover migration checklist + runbook. Looking to do a 90-min workshop + 30-min drop-in office hours. Who's available week of Apr 13? timezone: PDT/CEST friendly pls.

Devin (Solutions Eng): I can do Tue 2026-04-14 16:00 UTC or Thu 2026-04-16 09:00 UTC. Prefer Tue for longer lab time. Happy to demo upgrade steps and run a live migration plan.

Jordan (PM): Noted on renewal. Can we include a 10-min roadmap snippet? Might help renewals team. I'd join Tue afternoon.

Lee (Trainer): Proposed agenda (90m):
```
0-10m: intros + goals
10-40m: live walkthrough (migration + KV cache)
40-70m: hands-on lab (customers follow along)
70-80m: Q/A
80-90m: checklist + next steps
+ optional 30m office hours after
```
I can lead the hands-on lab. Need an attendee list and their roles.

Sara (CS Ops): Attendees: 6 total — 2 infra, 2 product, 2 eng. Onboarding status: 60% (tokenization pipeline still queued). Renewal risk: medium — flagged in Gainsight yesterday. I'll prep a short "must-fix before cutover" doc.

Mira (CSM): +1 to Tue. Also request we record and capture 3 pulse questions at end:
- Did the workshop make migration steps clear?
- Any blockers remaining?
- Confidence to proceed to cutover (1-5)

Calendar-bot: Proposed slots (react with :one: :two: :three:):
:one: Tue 2026-04-14 16:00 UTC (preferred)
:two: Thu 2026-04-16 09:00 UTC
:three: Fri 2026-04-17 13:00 UTC
Please react by EOD Fri.

Devin (Solutions Eng): :one: — confirmed. I'll prepare a small dataset and migration runbook Gist.

Jordan (PM): :one:

Lee (Trainer): :one: — will upload slide deck to shared drive, add lab instructions.

Sara (CS Ops): I'll draft the pulse survey and create a short Confluence page for "preflight checklist". I'll also send a calendar invite once slot confirmed.

Mira (CSM): Thanks all. @renewals FYI — we aim to have the checklist and recorded workshop before next billing milestone.

Calendar-bot: Booked: Tue 2026-04-14 16:00 UTC — 90m workshop + 30m office hours. Invite sent to attendees listed. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/ABC123 (auto-generated)
